sources.title: UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs, History of the UAE
sources.note: Official synthesis of treaty chronology, seasonal livelihoods, pearling collapse, oil exploration, and federation.

sources.title: Obaid Butti, Imperialism, Tribal Structure, and Ruling Elites in the Trucial States
sources.note: Doctoral study of British imperial relationships, tribal structures, and ruling elites from 1892 to 1939.

sources.title: Qatar Digital Library, 1892 Exclusive Agreement file
sources.note: Primary India Office file on drafting, signing, and ratifying the 1892 Exclusive Agreements.

sources.title: Qatar Digital Library, 1892 treaty clauses
sources.note: Primary treaty page recording restrictions on foreign relations, territorial cessions, and concessions.

sources.title: Visit Dubai, history facts about Dubai
sources.note: Official local history of Al Ahmadiya School, its patronage, pupils, fees, and curriculum.

sources.title: UAE National Cultural Map, Al Ahmadiya School
sources.note: Official heritage entry dating Dubai school construction to 1912 and describing outside teachers.

sources.title: Qatar Digital Library, Persian Gulf Administration Report for 1931
sources.note: Primary report on the pearl season, severe price decline, unsold stock, distress, and hunger.

sources.title: Qatar Digital Library, Trucial Coast disease file, 1935 to 1942
sources.note: Primary file containing case reports, bilingual telegrams, vaccines, quarantine, and Ralph Holmes vaccination totals.

sources.title: Qatar Digital Library, Trucial Coast food control file, 1942 to 1944
sources.note: Primary wartime records of flour and barley stocks, imports, consumption, allocation, and scarcity.

sources.title: Qatar Digital Library, Sharjah air station agreement, 1932
sources.note: Signed agreement between Sultan bin Saqr and British authorities for the Sharjah air station.

sources.title: Qatar Digital Library, Sharjah aerodrome construction
sources.note: Primary records for local labor, materials, construction, financing, and practical aerodrome arrangements.

sources.title: Qatar Digital Library, Sharjah oil concession file
sources.note: Primary records dating the 1937 commercial concession and related political agreement.

sources.title: Abu Dhabi Residents Office, History of Abu Dhabi
sources.note: Official local chronology of pearling, rulers, oil concession, early exploration, and later federation.

sources.title: Department of Culture and Tourism Abu Dhabi, Pearl Diving
sources.note: Official heritage account of seasonality, crews, roles, tools, children, ceremonies, and community participation.

sources.title: Department of Culture and Tourism Abu Dhabi, Purification of Drinking Water in the Past
sources.note: Named oral histories of clearing wells, settling water, cloth filtering, seepage collection, and women’s labor.

sources.title: Department of Culture and Tourism Abu Dhabi, The Zabil
sources.note: Official account of palm-frond baskets used for household storage, maritime work, and rubbish collection.

sources.title: Department of Culture and Tourism Abu Dhabi, Liwa Oasis
sources.note: Official heritage account of groundwater, dates, crops, animals, seasonal movement, forts, and Bani Yas settlement.

sources.title: UAE Ministry of Culture, Al Jahili Fort
sources.note: Official heritage description of the 1890s fort, mud brick, palm roofs, falaj, mosque, and ablution room.

sources.title: Department of Culture and Tourism Abu Dhabi, Emirati Culture and Traditions
sources.note: Government teaching resource on tents, palm houses, wind towers, cooling, household materials, and social space.

sources.title: British University in Dubai, Traditional Local Settlements
sources.note: Academic study of arish houses, settlement forms, public wells, local materials, and climatic responses.

sources.title: Frauke Heard-Bey, Historical Perspectives of Women in the UAE
sources.note: Peer-reviewed century-scale study of family life, domestic work, travel, education, employment, and changing roles.

sources.title: Frauke Heard-Bey, The Tribal Society of the UAE and its Traditional Economy
sources.note: Academic analysis of resource access, social structure, mobility, mixed livelihoods, and the limits of nomad stereotypes.

sources.title: Pearl Industry in the UAE Region, 1869 to 1938
sources.note: University research on the pearling economy, social hierarchy, minority financiers, labor, and regional networks.

sources.title: British University in Dubai, History of Education in the UAE
sources.note: Academic treatment of kuttab instruction, male and female teachers, pupils, curriculum, and semi-formal schools.

sources.title: Abu Dhabi Public Health Centre, Heritage Schools Guide
sources.note: Government guide to Al Ahmadiya School’s patron, subjects, palm mats, pupils, and preserved building.

sources.title: Qatar Digital Library, Map of Pearl Banks Used by Trucial Coast Divers
sources.note: Period primary map locating offshore banks used by Trucial Coast pearling crews in 1938.

sources.title: Qatar Digital Library, Lorimer Gazetteer on Trucial Coast epidemics
sources.note: Colonial compilation reporting smallpox in 1897 and 1900 while admitting uncertain origins and incomplete knowledge.

sources.title: Qatar Digital Library, Medical Quarantine and Sanitary Arrangements
sources.note: Primary administrative file on Gulf quarantine, medical advice, and Trucial Coast smallpox surveillance.

sources.title: Qatar Digital Library, Wartime Food Affordability
sources.note: Primary records of Dubai and Sharjah grain quantities, prices, and officials’ concern about affordability.

sources.title: Qatar Digital Library, Gulf Food Control, 1939 to 1945
sources.note: Primary file on import controls, allocations, re-export restrictions, wheat, barley, and wartime supply.

sources.title: Qatar Digital Library, Trucial Coast Agreement Collection
sources.note: Primary collection containing aviation, motor-launch, oil-company land, and wartime agreements through 1944.

sources.title: Qatar Digital Library, Sharjah Air Station Clauses
sources.note: Primary clauses for guards, a rest house, permitted imports, labor, and passenger movement into town.

sources.title: UAE Ministry of Culture, Al Sharia and Falaj Al Mualla
sources.note: Official heritage entry on an early nineteenth-century water channel and separate public water areas for women and men.

sources.title: UAE Ministry of Culture, Khor Fakkan Archaeological Site
sources.note: Official archaeological account of houses, roofs, fishing equipment, and long-lived maritime settlement evidence.

sources.title: United Nations, United Arab Emirates Member State
sources.note: Official record of UAE membership from December 1971, anchoring the federation date after this card.
